structure.name: Lending Indicators Housing Finance
structure.description: Dataset: LEND_HOUSING. Statistics on borrower-accepted commitments made for the purposes of housing lending. A borrower-accepted commitment is a firm offer to provide a loan which has been accepted by the borrower. Data is sourced from all Authorised Deposit-taking Institutions (ADIs) and Registered Financial Corporations (RFCs) that have significant lending activity in Australia. Unit of measure: AUD/Number. Geographic coverage: Australia/State. Catalogue number: 5601.0
